enchantments.tooltip: Ranged Alacrity 10%: Gain 10% Enhancement bonus to Ranged attack speed. Does not stack with the Haste spell.

Upgradeable Item (Black Abbot): This item could be upgraded if you found a Seal of the Black Abbot to combine it with. Bring this item to the Fountain of Necrotic Might outside the Black Mausoleum and combine it with a Seal of the Black Abbot to upgrade the item to a more powerful form.

children.tooltip: Striding +30%: This item makes you more fleet of foot, giving you a 30% Enhancement bonus your movement speed.
